items.summary_en: A succubus-style schoolgirl avatar with soft long blonde hair and little devil wings. Bust size adjusts steplessly from the radial menu, and spare swappable expressions are included.

items.title: 🗡Protocol Lapse🗡

items.summary_en: An outfit layering black leather belts and lace, like a cold-blooded enforcer. Glasses and a ponytail hairstyle are included as a set, and wielding the free bonus greatsword strikes a ready-made signature pose.

items.summary_en: An alluring set layering a China dress with striking gold-thread floral patterns over matching lingerie and a fur shawl. Comes in red, black, navy, and white, and stays sexy and photogenic even when undressed.

items.summary_en: A fusion of Chinese dress and sailor styling adorned with gold dragon embroidery. A cropped top bares the midriff over garters, and the set comes complete with an overcoat, hat, and shoes.

items.summary_en: A long-braided kemono-ear hairstyle with an adorable chick perched on top of the head. Lynx ears and tail are included, with a rich range of hair colors from pastels to black tones.
